title: Hybrid wear-rate model for monotone milling tool wear estimation: code and data
description: Code, processed data and results for the paper 'Monotone estimation of milling tool wear with a hybrid wear-rate model and conformal prediction intervals' (submitted to Measurement Science and Technology). An empirical wear law gives the expected wear increment of each milling pass, a small neural network fed with spindle current, vibration and acoustic emission descriptors scales it by a positive factor, and the running sum of the increments gives a non-decreasing flank wear estimate. Split conformal prediction adds 90 % intervals used for the tool-change decision. The repository reproduces all tables and figures of the paper from the public NASA Ames milling data set of Agogino and Goebel, which is downloaded by a script and not redistributed.
